item.title: Git official web site
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Git official web site
The home of Git: what it is and why (fast, distributed, free), its documentation and downloads, and Pro Git, the whole book by Scott Chacon and Ben Straub, free to read online.

Git official web site

About Git: https://git-scm.com/about1

Free Book

Pro Git (second edition), by Scott Chacon and Ben Straub, published by Apress: https://git-scm.com/book2

    1. Getting Started: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Getting-Started-About-Version-Control
    1. Git Basics: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Basics-Getting-a-Git-Repository
    1. Git Branching: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Branching-Branches-in-a-Nutshell
    1. Git on the Server: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-on-the-Server-The-Protocols
    1. Distributed Git: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Distributed-Git-Distributed-Workflows
    1. GitHub: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/GitHub-Account-Setup-and-Configuration
    1. Git Tools: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Tools-Revision-Selection
    1. Customizing Git: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Customizing-Git-Git-Configuration
    1. Git and Other Systems: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-and-Other-Systems-Git-as-a-Client
    1. Git Internals: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Plumbing-and-Porcelain
  • Appendix A: Git in Other Environments: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Appendix-A:-Git-in-Other-Environments-Graphical-Interfaces
  • Appendix B: Embedding Git in your Applications: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Appendix-B:-Embedding-Git-in-your-Applications-Command-line-Git
  • Appendix C: Git Commands: https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Appendix-C:-Git-Commands-Setup-and-Config
